item.description: The Chennai Central Express derailed near Jakhapura railway station in Odisha’s Jajpur district on Thursday, with three coaches slipping off the tracks. item.title: Forest department steps up preparedness to prevent forest fires ahead of Summer season
item.description: The Forest Department has stepped up preparedness to prevent forest fires across the state with the onset of summer. A series of preventive and monitoring measures have been put in place to minimise incidents and ensure quick response in vulnerable areas. The Principal Chief Conservator of Forests (PCCF) has issued a clear warning that strict action will be taken against individuals found deliberately setting forest fires. item.description: Three coaches of the Chennai–New Jalpaiguri Express derailed near Jakhapura station in Odisha’s Jajpur district on Thursday morning. Train No. 22611, operating between Chennai Central (MAS) and New Jalpaiguri (NJP), was moving at a very slow speed at the time of the derailment, officials said. item.title: 840 bottles of banned cough syrup seized in Bhadrak, 1 arrested
item.description: The Drugs Squad and Bhadrak Police on Wednesday seized 840 bottles of banned cough syrup from Basudebpur market in Odisha's Bhadrak district during a joint raid. The contraband was recovered from a local medical shop, where it was allegedly being sold illegally. Officials said the cough syrup was stored in seven boxes, each containing 120 bottles. item.title: Constable found dead at Nayagarh Police Reserve, probe on
item.description: A police constable was found dead under suspicious circumstances at the Nayagarh Reserve Police campus on Thursday, triggering shock among fellow personnel and raising questions over the circumstances leading to his death. The body was recovered from the roof of the Reserve Police barracks during the early hours of the morning. The deceased has been identified as Sunil Sethi, a 2023-batch police constable. He was a resident of Beruabari village under Odagaon police station in Nayagarh district.
